title: Cross-Canada · 21 Days · Alternate Return
subtitle: Nanaimo → Nipigon → home via Dryden · Yorkton · Brooks · Revelstoke · Hope

attribution.route: Route geometry via OSRM / OpenStreetMap (outbound + return corridor)
attribution.stops: Primary free overnight anchors curated from public iOverlander place pages

stops.name: Departure Bay Ferry Terminal
stops.label: Start · Nanaimo
stops.overview: Day 1 outbound ferry — and Day 21 return landing.
stops.description: BC Ferries Departure Bay. Reserve outbound and Day 21 return. Outbound matches v02; return uses new overnight towns.

stops.name: Horseshoe Bay Ferry Terminal
stops.label: Ferry · Horseshoe Bay
stops.overview: Mainland landing outbound; return ferry staging on Day 21.
stops.description: Hwy 1 east outbound (~4.5 h to Kamloops). Return: board Departure Bay sailing.

stops.name: Exhibition Park Baseball Fields
stops.label: Day 1 · Kamloops (free)
stops.overview: ~4.5 h from Horseshoe Bay.
stops.description: Exhibition Park baseball fields. Alternates: Sahali Mall or wild camping west of town.

stops.name: Golden Free RV Parking
stops.label: Day 2 · Golden (free)
stops.overview: ~4.9 h from Kamloops.
stops.description: Free RV parking / overnight stationnement. Staging for Banff day.

stops.name: Canmore 17 Street Parking
stops.label: Day 3 · Canmore / Banff (free)
stops.overview: ~2.3 h drive + Banff day-use.
stops.description: Sleep in Canmore; day-trip Lake Louise / Banff. Backup: Tunnel Mountain Village II.

stops.name: Quiet Spot off Hwy — Medicine Hat
stops.label: Day 4 · Medicine Hat (free)
stops.overview: ~4.8 h via Calgary.
stops.description: Quiet pull-off / visitor centre / Co-op. Paid backup: Gas City / Tillebrook.

stops.name: Swift Current Living Sky Casino
stops.label: Day 5 · Swift Current (free)
stops.overview: ~2.6 h — keeps Medicine Hat→Regina under 5 h.
stops.description: Living Sky Casino lot. Skipping this makes MH→Regina ~5.3 h.

stops.name: Cabela's Regina
stops.label: Day 6 · Regina (free)
stops.overview: ~2.7 h from Swift Current.
stops.description: Cabela's lot overnight.

stops.name: Dinsdale Park
stops.label: Day 7 · Brandon (free)
stops.overview: ~4.5 h from Regina.
stops.description: Dinsdale Park. Alternates: streetside laundry area, Brandon Hills entrance.

stops.name: Cabela’s Winnipeg
stops.label: Day 8 · Winnipeg (free)
stops.overview: ~2.7 h from Brandon.
stops.description: Cabela's lot. Alternate: Walmart. Verify overnight policy.

stops.name: Kenora Walmart
stops.label: Day 9 · Kenora (free)
stops.overview: ~3.1 h from Winnipeg.
stops.description: Walmart overnight. Next day stops at Ignace so Kenora→Thunder Bay never becomes ~7 h.

stops.name: Tolérance Hill Lookout
stops.label: Day 10 · Ignace (free)
stops.overview: ~3.6 h from Kenora — required Shield split.
stops.description: Tolérance Hill / White Otter Lookout. Next morning ~3.6 h to Thunder Bay.

stops.name: Mission Island Boat Launch
stops.label: Day 11 · Thunder Bay (free)
stops.overview: ~3.6 h from Ignace — staging for Nipigon / Superior.
stops.description: Boat launch / waterfront informal overnight. Alternate: Walmart Supercentre. Next day is a short Superior run to Nipigon (turnaround).

stops.name: Nipigon River Bridge
stops.label: Day 12 · Nipigon turnaround (free)
stops.overview: ~1.9 h from Thunder Bay — turnaround; return uses a different overnight ladder.
stops.description: Superior turnaround. Days 13–21 sleep in new towns (Dryden, Portage, Yorkton, Moose Jaw, Brooks, Calgary, Revelstoke, Hope) instead of reversing the outbound stops.

stops.name: Dryden Esso/Husky
stops.label: Day 13 · Dryden (free) · return
stops.overview: ~6.4 h from Nipigon — first new return overnight (skipped Ignace/Kenora).
stops.description: Esso/Husky lot overnight. Alternate corridor west without repeating Ignace or Kenora.

stops.name: Portage Mall
stops.label: Day 14 · Portage la Prairie (free) · return
stops.overview: ~6.0 h from Dryden — west of Winnipeg without sleeping in Winnipeg again.
stops.description: Portage Mall lot. Alternate: Shell Flying J. Skips Winnipeg and Brandon overnights.

stops.name: Yorkton Walmart
stops.label: Day 15 · Yorkton (free) · return
stops.overview: ~4.8 h from Portage — northern prairie line vs outbound Regina corridor.
stops.description: Walmart overnight. Alternates: Painted Hand Casino, tourist information lot.

stops.name: Moose Jaw Walmart
stops.label: Day 16 · Moose Jaw (free) · return
stops.overview: ~3.3 h from Yorkton — instead of Regina / Swift Current.
stops.description: Walmart overnight. Alternate: visitor centre lot.

stops.name: Brooks Walmart
stops.label: Day 17 · Brooks (free) · return
stops.overview: ~5.9 h from Moose Jaw — instead of Medicine Hat overnight.
stops.description: Walmart overnight. Alternates: Flying J, Co-op cardlock truck parking.

stops.name: Southcentre Mall
stops.label: Day 18 · Calgary (free) · return
stops.overview: ~2.4 h from Brooks — first Calgary overnight (outbound only drove through).
stops.description: Southcentre Mall lot. Alternate: Blackfoot Truck Stop. Verify overnight policy.

stops.name: Revelstoke informal
stops.label: Day 19 · Revelstoke (free) · return
stops.overview: ~5.6 h from Calgary — instead of Golden / Canmore sleep stops.
stops.description: Town informal overnight. Alternate: Griffith Creek trailhead recreation site.

stops.name: Hope Flying J
stops.label: Day 20 · Hope (free) · return
stops.overview: ~5.1 h from Revelstoke — staging for a short Day 21 ferry run (~2.3 h).
stops.description: Flying J Travel Center overnight. Alternate: Cascades & Canyons visitor centre lot. Next day: Hope → Horseshoe Bay + ferry home — no Kamloops overnight on this return.
